title: Gangnam Style Was Watched So Many Times It Broke YouTube's Counter

scenes.text: A music video was watched so many times it broke YouTube.
In December 2014, Gangnam Style passed 2,147,483,647 views.
That's the biggest number a 32-bit counter can hold.
YouTube's counter simply couldn't go any higher.
So YouTube posted: Gangnam Style has been viewed so many times we have to upgrade!
The video was over two billion views, and the counter had to be rebuilt.

description:
Gangnam Style broke YouTube's view counter in December 2014.
It passed 2,147,483,647 views, the largest number a 32-bit integer can store, and YouTube had to upgrade the counter.
What do you think the next counter-breaking video will be? Comment below.
first_comment: The limit was 2,147,483,647, a 32-bit number. What do you think was the first video you watched more than 100 times?
